Shared post-S2 callgraph consumers.

These helpers are intentionally read-only and deterministic: they consume the
SQLite-hydrated ``ctx.call_graph`` already attached to ContextPackage and
avoid stage-local re-derivation logic in s3/s4/s5/s6/s7/s8.

``ctx.call_graph`` is an entry-point/sink qnode index, not a call graph: it
carries file/function membership for the qnodes vvaharness's static
entry-point and sink detection identified, but no caller->callee edges and no
AST-derived def-site spans. :func:`qnodes_at` resolves against that file
membership; :func:`neighborhood` and :class:`GraphView`'s reverse-edge view
are therefore always empty by construction, not merely in practice. The
indices are built once per run and memoized per ContextPackage.
